newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea supplies 2.8 trln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea supplies 2.8 trln won to banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea said on Monday it supplied 2.8 trillion won to commercial banks through 12-day repurchase agreements to relieve the acute shortage of liquidity ahead of the September 26-29 Korean Thanksgiving holiday.
"We expect stability in the money market with the supply of 2.8 trillion won," said an official at the Bank of Korea.
Corporate cash demand is usually strong prior to the holiday as companies make bonus payments.
